conbody.p: Driver Attention Warning may not work properly in the following situations:

li.p: The vehicle frequently changes lanes and speed.
The vehicle is controlled by Driver Assistance system, such as Lane Keeping Assist
When the lane markings are blurred or erased

entry.p: If a vehicle cuts in front of your vehicle, Leading Departure Alert may not operate properly.

fig.title: When the vehicle ahead sharply steers

entry.p: If the vehicle in front makes a sharp turning, such as to turn left or right or making a U-turn, etc., Leading Vehicle Departure Alert may not operate properly.

fig.title: When the vehicle ahead abruptly departures

entry.p: If the vehicle in front abruptly departures, Leading Vehicle Departure Alert may not operate properly.

fig.title: When a pedestrian or bicycle is between you and the vehicle ahead

entry.p: If there is a pedestrian(s) or bicycle(s) in between you and the vehicle in front, Leading Vehicle Departure Alert may not operate properly.
If a vehicle parked in front drives away from you, Leading Vehicle Departure Alert may alert you that the parked vehicle is driving away.

fig.title: When driving at a tollgate or intersection

entry.p: If you pass a tollgate or intersection with lots of vehicles or you drive where lanes are merged or divided frequently, Leading Vehicle Departure Alert may not operate properly.

note.p: Driver Attention Warning may not operate for 15 seconds after the vehicle is started, or the front view camera is initialized.
